items.q: Is MultiClip Hub secure? Are my tokens protected?
items.a: We never store your passwords. We use each platform's official OAuth authentication — the same system as Buffer and Later. You connect directly through the platform without passing credentials through MultiClip Hub.

items.q: Does it work with verified / business accounts?
items.a: Yes. The official TikTok, Instagram and YouTube APIs accept personal, verified and business accounts. Just connect via OAuth and you're done.

items.q: What if a platform changes its API?
items.a: Our team tracks the official changelogs in real time. If an API changes, we update the connector within 24h and you get a proactive notification before any impact.
Yes, no penalty and no bureaucracy. Cancel from the dashboard in under 30 seconds. You keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.
Simultaneous publishing to all three platforms takes between 30 seconds and 3 minutes depending on video size and API queues. You get a notification when each platform confirms.

items.q: Is there a monthly video limit?
items.a: On the Clipper plan it's 200 posts/month. On the Pro and King plans posts are unlimited — the limit comes down to each platform's API quotas (TikTok: 5/day, Instagram: 25/day, YouTube: 50/day).
Data comes straight from the official APIs. Only videos published through MultiClip Hub are counted. The ranking updates every 6 hours and resets on the first day of each month.

items.q: Can I have more than one channel per platform?
items.a: On the Pro plan you connect up to 3 accounts per platform (9 channels total). On the King plan channels are unlimited, ideal for agencies and managers handling multiple creators.
